items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: Eddie Fife was a drummer who played with the original gang

ctx.x: He came about a couple days after he left.

And then Bob Mielke was a trombone player from San Francisco who played with our group and now he leads his own band out there, San Francisco. Eddie Fife was a drummer who played with the original gang and he's working around Washington, D.C. now.
Yeah. I think Jerry talked about it.
